runs.content: Staples lead the quarter and BAT trades at ~11.8x forward earnings with a ~5.6% yield and a running £1.3bn buyback, 8% below its 52-week high (prices in GBX; ITX trimmed for capacity).

TJX beat its Q3 plan with 4% comps and adjusted EPS of $1.34, raised its FY27 comp guide to 4%, and trades 17% below its 52-week high as an off-price trade-down beneficiary; VLO was trimmed for capacity at −12.15%.
